import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe

    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',

})

C_OBJ = '#009E73'
C_SPA = '#0072B2'

obj_rand_k =  [0.3,  0.5,  0.7,  0.85, 0.9,  0.925, 0.95, 1.0]

obj_l2_sr = [51.0, 33.4, 55.0, 98.0, 98.2, 98.2, 98.2]

        label='Object L2 Norm', zorder=5)

tool_args.old_string: We studied vision token pruning across seven VLA models (450M--7B) spanning three connector families on closed-loop LIBERO manipulation.
